items.why_en: An industry-first move to embed open-model video AI and agentic orchestration inline, pushing media workflows toward more integrated and autonomous processing.

items.title_zh: EvalDetectBench：衡量前沿语言模型评估感知能力的基准
items.title_en: EvalDetectBench: A Benchmark for Measuring Evaluation Awareness in Frontier Language Models
items.summary_zh: 前沿大语言模型常能意识到自己正在被评测，这种能力被称为“评估感知”。如果模型在评测与部署时的行为不一致，评测结果将失效，而评测却是目前AI安全框架的重要组成部分。作者提出EvalDetectBench，这是一个开放流水线与基准，可配合任意Inspect兼容的评测使用，使研究人员能面向当前和未来的基准度量评估感知。EvalDetectBench提供了现成的实现模块，便于把这些测试接入已有评测流程。这项工作有助于安全评测者识别并防范模型在评估中刻意改变行为所带来的风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier large language models can often recognize when they are being evaluated, a capability known as evaluation awareness. If models behave differently in evaluations than in deployment, this undermines the validity of evaluation results, which are a crucial component of current AI safety frameworks. We introduce EvalDetectBench, an open pipeline and benchmark for measuring evaluation awareness that works with any Inspect-compatible evaluation, allowing practitioners to test against current and future benchmarks. EvalDetectBench ships with a n…
items.why_zh: 为大模型安全评测提供了检测评估感知的标准工具，有助于防止模型在考核中刻意表现而掩盖真实风险。
items.why_en: It provides the community with a standard way to detect evaluation awareness, safeguarding the credibility of AI safety benchmarks.

items.title_zh: 信息共享何时能改进分散式发现？聚合、独立救援与均衡选择
items.title_en: When Does Information Sharing Improve Decentralized Discovery? Aggregation, Independent Rescue, and Equilibrium Selection
items.summary_zh: 在分散式发现任务中，信息共享既能提升汇总估计的准确性，也可能使个体放弃独立救援尝试，从而形成一正一反两种效应。该论文在有限精确发现模型中对二者进行分离分析，指出即使每个个体的单点准确率相同，不同行动预算组合也会导致最终组合价值差异。具体而言，在一种“注册后递增共享”协议下，仅当共享后的汇总残差收缩速度快于独立救援尝试时，共享才能改善发现任务。研究还观察到有限注册表中的压缩、聚合以及中性曲线等现象，为共享与自主行动的权衡提供了更细颗粒度的理论刻画。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Information sharing can improve a pooled estimate while eliminating independent rescue actions. This paper separates those effects in exact finite discovery models. A centralized action-budget profile shows that equal one-person accuracy can coexist with different portfolio values. Under a registered incremental-sharing protocol, a sharing step improves discovery exactly when pooled residual error contracts faster than an independent rescue attempt. Exact bounded registries exhibit compression, aggregation, neutral curves, and a bounded zero mixe…
items.why_zh: 为设计多代理信息共享机制提供了关键判定条件，帮助在协作收益和个体自主性之间取得平衡。
items.why_en: It clarifies exactly when sharing information aids decentralized discovery, informing balanced collaboration policies for multi-agent systems.

items.title_zh: SSAKG 2.0：用于结构化关联序列记忆和上下文检索的开源软件包
items.title_en: SSAKG 2.0: An Open-Source Package for Structural Associative Sequence Memory and Context-Based Retrieval
items.summary_zh: 本文发布SSAKG 2.0，一个构建并运行“结构化顺序关联知识图谱”的开源软件包。SSAKG将对象建模为图的顶点，并把有序序列编码为节点之间的结构连边，形成稀疏关联记忆图。这种设计允许系统只凭借部分且无序的上下文线索，即可重建完整的序列记忆。2.0版本新增了利用计算机内存单个比特特性来高效搜索图连接的算法，从而在大规模知识图谱上提升检索性能。该软件包可服务于需要联想记忆、序列补全和上下文检索的AI系统。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01849v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article presents SSAKG 2.0, an open-source software package for constructing and operating Structural Sequential Associative Knowledge Graphs (SSAKGs). An SSAKG represents objects as graph vertices and ordered sequences as structural patterns of graph connections. The resulting sparse graph is used as an associative memory in which complete sequences can be reconstructed from a partial, unordered context. Version 2.0 introduces new algorithms that exploit individual bits of computer memory to efficiently search graph connections. The package…
items.why_zh: 它提供了开源可用的结构联想记忆实现，有望让AI具备从碎片化上下文恢复完整序列的能力。
items.why_en: Provides an accessible, efficient toolkit for structural associative memory, enabling AI systems to reconstruct complete sequences from context fragments.

items.title_zh: 记忆信任差距：持久记忆代理中随能力变化的失败机制
items.title_en: The Memory Trust Gap: Capability-Dependent Failures in Persistent-Memory Agents
items.summary_zh: 持久记忆能为AI代理提供个性化能力，但也带来一个新风险：记忆中过时的事实可能不加警示地覆盖当前权威证据，从而引向错误行为。为厘清模型能力变化如何影响这一危害，作者构建了一个冻结、闭集、动作评分的基准，包含两套子任务：一套要求模型依靠存储事实才能解决，以体现记忆的收益；另一套则让权威工具始终给出正确值，用于检测模型是否会无端信任错误记忆。作者在同族的Qwen3系列（0.6/1.7/4/8B）上进行评估，以观察不同能力水平下“记忆信任差距”的出现规律。该基准为持久记忆代理的安全设计提供了可复用的评测维度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Persistent memory supports personalized agents, but a stale stored fact can override current authoritative evidence without warning. We study when this harm begins as model capability changes. We evaluate a frozen, closed-set, action-scored benchmark with 2 suites that represent 2 different meanings of "no memory" (a Benefit suite, unsolvable without the stored fact, and a Safety suite, in which an authoritative tool always holds the correct value), on a same-family model-size series (Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B). The Memory Trust Gap reflects over-trust…
items.why_zh: 揭示了持久记忆类AI的安全隐患：模型需要学会让权威事实否决过时存档，避免错误决策。
items.why_en: It highlights a safety risk for memory-equipped agents and provides a benchmark to align capability growth with proper trust in stored information.

items.title_zh: 雅可比透镜下的循环Transformer：循环中能否保留全局工作空间？
items.title_en: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?
items.summary_zh: 近期研究发现，前馈Transformer的中间层存在一个可口头表达且对输出有强因果作用的表征带，其功能类似于认知科学中的“全局工作空间”。然而当Transformer通过循环使用同一批权重来实现深度而非堆叠独立层时，这种工作空间机制还能否出现仍是未解问题。该论文将雅可比（Jacobian）分析框架通过“虚拟展开”适配器推广到迭代架构，用于检查循环模型在每一轮深度中的可读取表征。研究者以此考察环回和深度循环Transformer是否会在循环过程中形成可描述、因果有力的中间状态。这项工作为理解不同深度实现方式对模型可解释性和控制力的影响提供了新视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent work identifies a mid-depth band of verbalisable, causally potent representations in a standard feedforward transformer --- a functional analogue of a global workspace. Whether the same workspace functionality emerges when depth is implemented through recurrence rather than a stack of distinct layers remains unknown. Looped and depth-recurrent transformers provide a direct test of this question because they reuse the same weights across depth. We extend the Jacobian lens to iterated architectures using a virtual-unrolling adapter. We apply…
items.why_zh: 解答循环Transformer能否不靠堆叠独立层也维持全局工作区功能，对高效可解释架构有直接启示。
items.why_en: It tests a key architectural hypothesis: recurrence can replace layer stacking without losing the global workspace-like coordination vital for agentic reasoning.

items.title_zh: 语言模型统计问题公式化能力基准
items.title_en: Benchmarking Language Models for Statistical Problem Formulation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地充当统计与数据科学助手，但现有评测大多默认用户已经指明了分析目标。实际场景往往是用户只给出含糊诉求和杂乱数据，需要模型自行判断该做什么统计任务、用哪些数据。该论文将这一前置环节命名为“统计问题公式化”，并拆成两个子任务：统计问题分类和变量识别与角色分配。论文提出通过专门基准来考察模型是否具备把模糊需求转化为可执行统计问题的能力，而不是仅仅评估其解算已定问题的水平。这项工作有望让AI统计助手从工具执行者升级为真正理解问题意图的分析咨询顾问。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as assistants for statistical and data science work, yet existing evaluations largely assume the analysis target is already specified. In practice, users arrive with informal goals and heterogeneous data, leaving the model to decide what statistical task is implied and which data are relevant. We first formalize this upstream step as Statistical Problem Formulation and decompose it into two subtasks: (1) Statistical Problem Classification and (2) Variable Identification & Role Assignment. We then…
items.why_zh: 把大模型在数据科学中的能力评估向前推进到需求理解阶段，对提升自动化分析工具的可用性至关重要。
items.why_en: It draws attention to a missing evaluation dimension—problem formulation—making LLM-based data science assistants far more practical for real-world, ambiguous requests.

items.title_zh: HeadWiseKV：混合长上下文语言模型的每头KV缓存驻留预算管理
items.title_en: HeadWiseKV: Budgeted Per-Head Cache Residency for Hybrid Long-Context Language Models
items.summary_zh: 长期上下文推理中，解码阶段不断增长的KV缓存成为显存瓶颈，在混合长上下文模型中尤为突出。HeadWiseKV提出了一种无需训练的框架，在给定的KV驻留总预算下，对模型中残余全局注意力层的缓存进行压缩，同时保留模型原生的局部、循环等注意力机制。该方法将缓存分配问题转化为按头（per-head）的驻留预算管理，旨在降低解码时GPU内存占用并维持生成性能。该技术为长上下文模型的高效推理提供了轻量级优化思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-context inference retains a growing key--value (KV) cache during decoding, which consumes substantial GPU memory and can reduce generation throughput. This bottleneck remains in hybrid language models because their residual global-attention layers can dominate context-dependent cache demand. We study how to allocate this state under an aggregate KV-residency budget. We introduce HeadWiseKV, a training-free framework that compresses the residual global KV caches of hybrid language models while preserving their native local, recurrent, and lin…
items.why_zh: 它提供了无需训练的缓存预算压缩方案，直接缓解了长上下文推理中的显存瓶颈，对大规模部署意义重大。
items.why_en: It offers a training-free way to manage per-head KV cache budgets, easing a key memory limitation for hybrid long-context inference.

items.title_zh: 无内部信号的Web智能体监控：可观测轨迹与关键步骤监督
items.title_en: Monitoring Web Agents Without Internal Signals: Observable Trajectories and Key-Step Supervision
items.summary_zh: 在模型内部不确定性信号（如token对数概率）不可用时，可靠地监控Web智能体的执行变得困难。该研究聚焦于前缀级别的风险预测，即根据可观测的轨迹信号，估计当前执行是否仍在正确轨道上或趋向失败。作者提出了两类可观测轨迹表示：宏观特征（Macro）从跨步骤的智能体-环境互动与反馈中提取总体状态；微观特征（Micro）则衡量意图、行动和预期结果之间的一致性。基于这些特征可对执行前缀进行早期风险识别，为缺乏内部信号的智能体系统提供外部监控方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable web-agent monitoring is difficult when model-internal uncertainty signals such as token logits are unavailable. In this work, we study prefix-level risk prediction for web agents using observable trajectory signals: given an evolving prefix, estimate whether the current execution remains on track or is tending toward failure. We derive two observable trajectory representations: Macro features summarize cross-step agent--environment behavior and feedback, while Micro features measure the consistency of intention, action, and anticipated s…
items.why_zh: 当无法获取模型内部置信度时，该研究用外部轨迹信号支撑Web智能体的可靠监控，对保障自主代理安全执行很有价值。
items.why_en: It provides a practical monitoring signal for web agents when internal signals are inaccessible, boosting the reliability and trustworthiness of autonomous systems.

items.title_zh: DocHop：信息密集文档中的跨域多跳推理基准
items.title_en: DocHop: Benchmarking Out-of-domain Multi-hop Reasoning in Information-Dense Documents
items.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型在图表问答和文档问答等结构化视觉理解任务上表现优异，但现有基准通常将图表与文档场景分开评估，忽视了模型需要结合文本上下文来决定如何选择、解释并聚合图表证据的关键能力。为此，研究者提出DocHop基准，用于文档风格图像中的图表-上下文集成推理。在该基准中，文档叙述规定了一个多步推理流程，模型必须跟踪相关条件与约束，综合不同来源的视觉与文字信息，跨出单一领域的限制进行多跳推理。该基准有望填补多模态推理评测中图表与上下文协同能力的空白，并检验模型在信息密集场景下的深层理解。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on structured visual understanding tasks such as chart and document question answering. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these domains in isolation, leaving underexplored a key capability: whether models can use textual context to determine how chart evidence should be selected, interpreted, and aggregated. We introduce DocHop, a benchmark for integrated chart--context reasoning in document-style images. In DocHop, the document narrative specifies multi-step…
items.why_zh: 它测的是多模态模型在真实信息密集型文档中把图表与文本结合起来多步推理的能力，填补了现有评测盲区。
items.why_en: It addresses an underexplored benchmark gap by measuring joint chart-and-context multi-hop reasoning, a critical skill for real-world document understanding.

items.title_zh: ToolGate：工具依赖型科学基准的可执行验收流水线
items.title_en: ToolGate: An Executable Acceptance Pipeline for Tool-Dependent Scientific Benchmark Construction
items.summary_zh: 科学基准通常由领域专家手工编写和互查，或者改编自教材、论文和在线资料，虽然质量高但需要大量人工成本。语言模型可以快速生成候选题目，但如何确保候选题目合格是一大挑战。该研究聚焦于那些答案必须借助专业软件计算而非仅靠推理的科学问题，提出了ToolGate，一个可执行的验收流水线，以自动判断语言模型生成的候选题目是否有效。验收过程要求题目能够通过实际执行工具得到明确答案，从而在降低构建成本的同时保证基准的可靠性与可复现性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific benchmarks are commonly built by domain experts who write tasks and cross-check one another's work, or who adapt existing material from textbooks, published papers, and online resources. These routes can produce strong evaluations, but they require substantial per-item labor. Language models can reduce this repeated work by proposing candidates quickly. The remaining problem is acceptance. We target scientific questions whose answers require computations with specialist software rather than unaided reasoning alone. A candidate is inval…
items.why_zh: 它把大模型引入科学基准构建的同时用“可执行”设为准入条件，有望大幅降低高质量评测数据的构建成本。
items.why_en: It lowers the cost of building rigorous scientific benchmarks by accepting only LM candidates that can be verified through real execution, ensuring quality without exhaustive manual curation.

items.title_zh: CHIME：面向长时程智能体规划的信用感知分层记忆演化
items.title_en: CHIME: Credit-Aware Hierarchical Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agentic Planning
items.summary_zh: 规划能力让智能体能够将复杂的长时程任务分解为可管理的步骤。现有的测试时搜索和基于训练的方法要么推理开销大，要么需要昂贵的训练数据。自我演化记忆方法将智能体与环境的交互结果积累到外部记忆库中，使规划能力在推理阶段可以持续改进，无需更新参数。然而，此类方法普遍面临信用分配难题：它们往往难以判断交互结果中的哪些经验对成功贡献最大。为此，研究者提出CHIME，一种信用感知的分层记忆演化框架，通过为不同层级的经验分配合理的信用，优化记忆的累积与复用，从而提升长时程agent规划的效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planning is a central capability that enables agents to decompose complex long-horizon tasks into manageable steps. Test-time search and training-based methods improve planning but incur high inference costs or require expensive training data. Self-evolving memory instead accumulates reusable experience from agent interaction outcomes into an external memory bank, so planning capability keeps improving at inference time without parameter updates. However, existing self-evolving memory methods share an inherent credit assignment problem: they rely…
items.why_zh: 该研究破解了自我演化记忆中“经验贡献归因不清”的瓶颈，使智能体无需重训即可更聪明地积累和复用规划经验。
items.why_en: It improves the efficiency of self-evolving planning memory by solving credit assignment, enabling long-horizon agents to learn from experience during inference without extra training.

items.title_zh: FUSE：评估LLM危险能力的模块化框架
items.title_en: FUSE: An Evaluating Framework for Dangerous Capabilities of LLMs
items.summary_zh: 针对危险AI能力的治理常常因碎片化的安全评估而受阻。为此，该工作提出了一个模块化评估框架FUSE，以统一协议下的三条正交管线——知识（K）、防御（D）和危害（H）——对每个模型进行评估，并将结果聚合为标准化的危险能力档案。框架中的可插拔模块可为不同应用场景提供场景种子、知识库、危害查询和评判标准，而核心评估引擎在不同领域保持一致。这一设计使得评估过程既灵活又可比较，便于对模型潜在危险能力进行系统化度量。摘要还提到FUSE可支持网络安全等领域的试点演示，但具体细节未完整披露。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fragmented safety evaluation undermines the governance of dangerous AI capabilities. We present a modular framework that evaluates each model through three orthogonal pipelines---Knowledge ($K$), Defense ($D$), and Harm ($H$)---under a unified protocol, aggregating results into a standardized dangerous-capability profile $\phi$. Pluggable modules supply scenario seeds, knowledge banks, hazard queries, and judge rubrics, while the core evaluation engine remains unchanged across domains; the CB evaluation is complemented by a cyber pilot demonstrat…
items.why_zh: 它为碎片化的LLM安全评估提供了统一且可扩展的度量标准，有助于系统性比较和监管不同模型的风险。
items.why_en: It delivers a common, modular measuring stick for dangerous LLM capabilities, enabling more consistent safety governance and cross-model comparison.

items.title_zh: 提出以学习，学习以提出：有限理性下的可评估性感知辅助
items.title_en: Propose to Learn, Learn to Propose: Evaluability-Aware Assistance under Bounded Rationality
items.summary_zh: AI助手常常通过提出候选的编辑、计划或设计来与用户协作，再由用户在采纳前进行评估。现有的辅助方法主要关注提案质量和用户目标推断，通常假设用户能够可靠地评估任何提案，但在现实里用户受有限理性限制，未必能做到。这项研究关注“可评估性感知”的提案规划，即既把提案视为任务干预，也将其视为探测用户潜在偏好与评估约束的“探针”；模型基于用户的反馈更新对用户偏好的信念，并据此规划后续提案。这种双向利用使助手能够在不要求用户完美评估的前提下逐步提升协助质量。该研究让AI得以在与用户的交互中主动学习，适应真实用户的认知局限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI assistants often collaborate by proposing candidate edits, plans, or designs that users evaluate before adoption. Existing assistance methods focus on proposal quality or user-goal inference, often assuming that the user can reliably evaluate any proposal, which can fail in practice because of bounded rationality. We study evaluability-aware proposal planning, where proposals serve both as task interventions and as probes for learning latent preferences and evaluation constraints, where the resulting belief updates then guide later proposals.…
items.why_zh: 它挑战了“用户总能评价提案”的理想假设，让AI在真实人机协作中更主动、更务实地学习用户偏好。
items.why_en: It relaxes unrealistic assumptions about user eval能力 and makes AI assistants adaptive in real-world settings where human evaluation is imperfect.

items.title_zh: APEx：面向自适应深度研究问答的智能体程序性经验蒸馏
items.title_en: APEx: Distillation of Agent Procedural Experience for Adaptive Deep Research Question Answering
items.summary_zh: 深度研究智能体通过调用外部工具、进行多轮推理来回答复杂且长时程的问题。持续改进依赖从以往经验中学习，然而现有方法要么检索冗长且针对具体任务的轨迹，增加决策负担；要么提炼出过程技能，却与下游策略的适应性调整相脱离。为此，研究者提出APEx，一种分层经验利用框架，它将交互历史组织成实例级轨迹记忆与类别级程序性经验，并从中蒸馏结构化流程知识，以支持深度研究问答的持续改进。通过这样的方式，APEx试图在保留详细经验与实现自适应策略之间找到平衡，减少无效信息对决策的干扰，提升智能体对多变任务的适应能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep research agents augment large language models with external tools to answer complex, long-horizon questions through multi-turn reasoning. Learning from prior experience is crucial for continual improvement, yet existing methods either retrieve verbose task-specific traces that burden decision-making, or distill procedural skills that remain decoupled from downstream policy adaptation. We propose APEx, a hierarchical experience utilization framework that organizes interaction history into instance-level trajectory memories and category-level…
items.why_zh: 它为深度研究智能体提供了一条从过往任务中提炼可迁移过程经验的自适应路径，推动这类智能体在复杂长时问题上的持续进化。
items.why_en: It enables deep research agents to continuously refine their strategies by distilling procedural experience from past interactions, directly improving their adaptive capability over time.

items.title_zh: CoMerge：面向多任务模型合并的冲突驱动偏好优化
items.title_en: CoMerge: Conflict-Driven Preference Optimization for Multi-Task Model Merging
items.summary_zh: 模型合并为构建多任务大语言模型（LLM）提供了一种无需完整训练的高效范式，但仍面临参数干扰的挑战。现有方法大多致力于保留各个专家模型的能力并缓解干扰，却很少从朴素合并所暴露出的性能退化中学习。为此，本文提出一种面向模型合并的冲突驱动偏好优化框架（CoMerge），将模型合并重新表述为偏好优化问题，从冲突视角直接学习如何改善合并结果。该框架有望缓解多任务合并中的参数冲突，提升合并后模型对多个任务的综合表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02273v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model merging provides an efficient paradigm for constructing multi-task large language models (LLMs) without full model retraining, yet it remains challenged by parameter interference. While existing methods aim to preserve the capabilities of individual expert models and mitigate interference, they generally do not directly learn from the potentially degraded behaviors exposed by naive merging. In this paper, we propose a conflict-driven preference optimization framework for model merging (CoMerge), which reformulates model merging as a prefere…
items.why_zh: 将模型合并从“规避冲突”转向“在冲突中学习”，为多任务模型融合提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It reframes model merging as a preference learning task, enabling models to improve by learning from conflicts rather than merely avoiding interference.

items.title_zh: UTP-Bench：不确定性感知的旅行规划基准
items.title_en: UTP-Bench: Uncertainty-aware Travel Planning Benchmark
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在自动生成旅行行程方面已展现出较强能力，但现实旅行规划充满不确定性：交通延误、人流量波动和随机延迟常使原本可行的计划失效。现有基准如 TravelPlanner 和 TripCraft 均假设确定性环境，只评估静态约束满足情况，而忽略计划在不确定性下是否仍具鲁棒性。为此，本文提出 UTP-Bench，一个不确定性感知的旅行规划评测基准，旨在系统评估生成计划在动态环境中的可靠性与健壮性，以弥补现有评测的不足。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in automated travel itinerary generation. However, real- world travel planning is inherently uncertain: transportation delays, crowd fluctuations, and unexpected stochastic delays frequently inval- idate otherwise feasible schedules. Existing benchmarks like TravelPlanner and TripCraft assume deterministic environments, evaluating only static constraint satisfaction and ignoring whether generated plans remain robust when such uncertainties arise. To address this limitatio…
items.why_zh: 弥补了现有旅行规划评测忽略不确定性的不足，推动构建真正可落地的 AI 旅行助手。
items.why_en: It fills the gap in travel planning evaluation by considering real-world uncertainties, pushing LLM-based agents toward robust and deployable itinerary generation.

items.title_zh: Repo-To-Skill：将 GitHub 仓库蒸馏为 AI4AI 技能
items.title_en: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
items.summary_zh: 自主 Agent 正开始端到端地执行机器学习（ML）研究任务。这类 Agent 通常将模型主干与用于规划、执行、记忆和验证的支架（harness）相结合，但领域特定的“操作知识”——即知道一个方法到让它真正起作用之间的诀窍——仍不在 Agent 内部。这些知识其实大量存在于代码仓库和论文中，但写作对象是人类读者，且规模过大无法在单个任务中全部加载。为此，本文提出 Repo-To-Skill，旨在把 GitHub 仓库中的这类实践知识蒸馏为结构化的、可供 Agent 调用的技能，从而补全自主 ML 研究所缺失的“操作知识”层。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous agents are beginning to carry out machine-learning (ML) research end to end. These agents combine a model backbone with a harness for planning, execution, memory, and verification, but this architecture still leaves domain-specific know-how outside the agent. We call this missing layer operational knowledge, the know-how that separates knowing a method from making it work. That knowledge is not absent from the field. It appears in repositories and papers, but in forms written for human readers and too large to load during a task. Once…
items.why_zh: 将人类沉淀在代码库中的领域知识转化为 Agent 可用的技能，是推进 AI4AI 自主研究的关键一步。
items.why_en: It bridges the gap between human-written domain knowledge and agent-executable operations, a crucial step toward fully autonomous ML research.

items.title_zh: 双层协调反思：多智能体 LLM 系统的博弈论方法
items.title_en: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.summary_zh: 多智能体LLM系统通常由一个编排器（orchestrator）将任务分解给多个工作智能体，并通过文本反思来改进结果。尽管这类系统经验表现强劲，但对于协调、记忆改进以及外部验证的作用一直缺少统一的理论解释。本文将编排器与工作智能体之间的交互建模为一个双层协调博弈：在有界耦合条件下，工作智能体的局部更新博弈近似为一个势博弈，其均衡松弛程度由任务分解质量决定。文章进一步对基于文本的反思过程进行了理论分析，为多智能体系统中的协调与持续改进提供了博弈论基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02750v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems commonly use an orchestrator to decompose a task for a team of workers and then improve through textual reflection. Despite strong empirical results, these systems lack a unified account of coordination, memory improvement, and the role of external verification. We model orchestrator-worker interaction as a bilevel coordination game: under bounded coupling, the workers' local-update game is an approximate potential game whose equilibrium slack is controlled by decomposition quality. We then analyse reflection as stochastic…
items.why_zh: 为多智能体 LLM 系统的协调与反思提供了数学化解释，有助于从理论层面理解并改进此类系统。
items.why_en: It provides a game-theoretic foundation for coordination and reflection in multi-agent LLM systems, enabling deeper understanding and principled design.

items.title_zh: SafeEvolve：面向安全对齐的智能体支架与策略协同进化
items.title_en: SafeEvolve: Harness-Policy Co-Evolution from Agent Experience for Safety Alignment
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体行为由基础模型与其在环境中交互所使用的支架（harness）共同决定，这使得它们同时面临有害最终回应与多步执行轨迹方面的安全风险。现有安全对齐机制往往要么只更新外部支架，要么只进行策略优化，单独任何一种范式都无法将运行时控制与内在安全性真正结合。针对这一问题，本文提出 SafeEvolve，一个由经验驱动的自进化安全对齐框架，利用智能体在环境交互中的经验来协同演化支架与策略，从而同时提升最终输出和中间步骤的安全性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The performance of LLM-based agents is jointly shaped by the base model and the harness used when interacting with the environment. This exposes them to safety risks in both harmful final responses and multi-step execution trajectories. Existing safety alignment mechanisms often rely on either external harness updates or policy optimization, yet applying either paradigm in isolation fails to bridge runtime control with intrinsic safety. We propose SafeEvolve, an experience-driven self-evolving framework for agent safety alignment. SafeEvolve leve…
items.why_zh: 提出同时考虑外部控制与内在安全的自进化对齐机制，为构建安全可信的 LLM Agent 提供了新途径。
items.why_en: It advances agent safety by jointly evolving harness and policy from experience, overcoming the limitation of previous single-sided alignment.

items.title_zh: AICOME：面向恢复个体与群体效应的 AI 上下文测量
items.title_en: AI Contextual Measurement for Recovering Individual and Group-Level Effects: Validation Against Survey Measures and an Occupational Application
items.summary_zh: 研究者日益使用人工智能来构建传统调查数据中缺失的社会、组织和职业特征测量。本文提出 AICOME（AI 上下文测量）框架，用于评估 AI 生成的受访者级测量能否在上下文模型中恢复个体与群体水平效应。其核心思路是：利用受访者级的 AI 测量可以得到其群体级聚合值与个体离差，从而使研究者能同时估计上下文效应和个体效应。论文还基于调查测量对该框架进行了验证，并将其应用于一个职业相关场景，为社会科学中的 AI 测量提供了系统性评估方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Researchers increasingly use artificial intelligence to construct measures of social, organizational, and occupational characteristics that are absent from conventional surveys. We propose AICOME, AI COntextual MEasurement, a framework for evaluating whether AI-derived respondent-level measures can recover individual and group-level effects in contextual models. The key idea is that an AI measure constructed at the respondent level can be used to derive its group-level aggregate and its individual deviation, allowing researchers to estimate both…
items.why_zh: 该框架为检验 AI 生成测量在社会科学研究中的统计有效性提供了关键方法，有助于负责任地使用 AI 测量工具。
items.why_en: It addresses a critical need for validating AI-derived measurements in social science, supporting reliable use of AI-generated variables.

items.title_zh: 英国议会两个世纪的性别歧视：基于 Hansard 语料的女性代表性计算分析
items.title_en: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus
items.summary_zh: 本项工作对英国议会两百年（1803–2005）的 Hansard 辩论语料进行了大规模计算分析，研究对象为 6,531 篇涉及女性权利的演讲。借助大语言模型（LLM），作者对演讲者关于妇女选举权和政治代表性的立场进行分类，并运用“矛盾性别歧视量表”（Ambivalent Sexism Inventory）分析议会语言中隐含的性别歧视模式。分析揭示，议会讨论妇女权利的语言——即使是支持性的论述——也系统性地带有性别歧视特征。作者同时发布了整理有序、附带丰富元数据的议会数据集，供后续研究使用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.30485v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The language a legislature uses to debate women's rights, even in favour of them, encodes systematic patterns of sexism that persist across two centuries. In this work, we analyse 6,531 speeches over 200 years of UK parliamentary debate (Hansard, 1803-2005) by using large language models to classify a speaker's perspective towards women's suffrage and political representation, as well as analyse sexist speech in parliament from the lens of the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory. We also release this parliamentary dataset, an organized and metadata-enr…
items.why_zh: 利用 LLM 对两百年议会语料进行系统性性别偏见分析，并以数据集形式公开结果，为历史与性别研究提供了大规模可重复证据。
items.why_en: It provides a large-scale computational account of sexist language in political discourse over 200 years and releases the dataset for broader research.

items.title_zh: RecEvolve：知识驱动的推荐系统自主智能体框架
items.title_en: RecEvolve: A Knowledge-Driven Autonomous Agent System for Recommender Systems
items.summary_zh: Agentic AI 的兴起正推动系统向自我迭代演进，为生产级推荐模型的自主优化创造了新可能。本文展示了一个知识驱动的自主智能体系统 RecEvolve，它被直接部署在工业级的大规模双塔检索模型上。系统将完整的研究生命周期——包括想法提出、代码实现、离线训练和指标评估——都交给一个持续闭环的自主框架执行，并在真实环境中运行了多轮实验（原文提及超过 40 次“comp…”）。该工作为知识驱动智能体在生产推荐系统中的实践提供了实证验证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01622v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rise of agentic AI has catalyzed a shift toward self-iterating systems, opening new frontiers for the autonomous optimization of production recommender models. This paper presents the empirical validation of a knowledge-driven autonomous agent system, deployed directly on a production large-scale Two-Tower retrieval model. By delegating the entire research lifecycle, spanning idea generation, code implementation, offline training, and metric evaluation, to a continuous closed-loop autonomous framework, the agent system executed over 40 comp…
items.why_zh: 展示了自主智能体在真实工业级推荐系统上直接承担完整研究流程的可行性，是 AI 自动化工程的重要实践。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a real-world deployment of an agentic loop in a production recommender system, highlighting the practical potential of autonomous ML research.
